verdict: Ais kacang (ABC) is lighter, an estimated ~300 kcal compared to cendol at ~350 kcal. Its fat is also much lower because there's not much santan (coconut milk).
why: ABC is an estimated ~300 kcal, cendol ~350 kcal. About a 50 kcal difference per bowl.
ABC has only 4 g fat, cendol 13 g. Most of cendol's fat comes from santan.
ABC has 5 g protein (from red beans and corn), cendol 4 g. Both are low, so don't expect them to replace a meal.
Both are easy to finish fast because they're cold and sweet, especially in the scorching heat.
when_a: Cendol suits you when you're out and really want that authentic cendol taste. Sharing a bowl with your partner is already satisfying.
when_b: ABC suits as dessert after a light lunch, for example rice with fish and vegetables.
tip: Ask for less gula melaka or less condensed milk. Even better, share one bowl between two.

faq.q: ABC has beans and corn, so it counts as healthy?
faq.a: It has a little fibre and protein, but the syrup and condensed milk make the calories high. Enjoy it as dessert, not as a main meal.

faq.q: Can I eat cendol while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes. The key is frequency and size. Once a week or sharing between two fits more easily into your daily calories.
